commits.subject: crypt: ECrypt now inherits from ESynCrypto
commits.body:
Since bc82aa795 the authentication side of mormot.crypt.secure raises
ESynCrypto while the Rnd/Hash/Sign/Cipher/Asym/Cert/Store factories raise
ECrypt, and the two classes were siblings under ESynException: an
`except on ECrypt` handler around e.g. TObjectWithPassword.GetPasswordSafe
silently stopped catching, and no single class covered the whole
cryptographic stack.

ECrypt is now a descendant of ESynCrypto, so `on ESynCrypto` catches
everything from mormot.crypt.core up to the factories, as agreed in #737.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: tests: DHCP scope selection of DISCOVER with ciaddr, and of RELEASE
commits.body:
Cover the no-relay rules of 282c8626a: ciaddr is ignored for DISCOVER, and
used for RELEASE even when received on another interface. The existing tests
pass with DISCOVER included and RELEASE excluded from the ciaddr type set:
this mutation fails exactly the three new assertions. Tested on x86_64 Linux
and aarch64: 89,145 assertions, no failure.
commits.author: zen010101
